videos.caption: 🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Information about her parents remained unclear following the rescue, which has become a powerful moment of hope amid the devastating floods that have claimed numerous lives across Nepal. #Nepal #Rasuwa #Rescue #Floods #SurvivalStory

Imagine losing everything in a devastating flood, only to face paperwork when asking for help. 💔🇳🇵 Families affected by the Budhigandaki floods in Dhading's Tripurasundari Rural Municipality have raised concerns about access to relief. According to residents featured in a circulating video, some families originally registered in Gorkha had lived in the Arughat area for years before losing their homes. They allege they were asked to provide migration certificates when seeking assistance. The government has announced temporary housing support for eligible flood victims, but the residents' complaints remain unresolved in available reporting. Should emergency relief depend on permanent-address documentation? Source: Social Media  #NepalFloods #Dhading #FloodRelief #NepalNews #Budhigandaki

Kathmandu is the capital and largest city of Nepal, Kathmandu is the main governmental, financial, industrial, and cultural centre of Nepal. The cultural heritage of the Kathmandu Valley is illustrated by seven groups of monuments and buildings which display the full range of historic and artistic achievements for which the Kathmandu Valley is world famous.
